newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber mostly slips on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber mostly slips on technical selling.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower on Monday as caution over price rises last week stimulated technical-driven sales, traders said.
Weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan were also a bearish factor for the market, they said.
Rubber prices ranged from 3.7 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen higher. Benchmark January was down 0.5 yen at 122.9 yen.

"Caution over recent price rises stimulated selling in distant months, which spilled over into other months," a trader said. "Prices are likely to hover around current levels in an attempt to consolidate," he said.
